@export var click_volume_db: float = -4.0
@export var min_pitch: float = 0.95
@export var max_pitch: float = 1.05

@onready var feedback: QuizAudioFeedback = $Feedback
@onready var music: QuizMusicPlayer = $Music
@onready var click_player: AudioStreamPlayer = $ClickPlayer


func play_click() -> void:
	var random_pitch: float = randf_range(min_pitch, max_pitch)
	click_player.pitch_scale = random_pitch
	click_player.volume_db = click_volume_db
	click_player.play()


func play_answer_feedback(is_correct: bool) -> void:
	feedback.play_feedback(is_correct)


func start_bg_music() -> void:
	music.play_music()


func stop_bg_music() -> void:
	music.stop_music()


func is_click_playing() -> bool:
	return click_player.playing
